title: Add a helper to format durations
body: Small utility used by the reporting module. Covered by a new unit test.

files.patch:
@@ -10,3 +10,9 @@ def format_bytes(n):
     for unit in ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"]:
         if n < 1024:
             return f"{n:.1f}{unit}"
         n /= 1024
+
+def format_seconds(total):
+    minutes, seconds = divmod(int(total), 60)
+    if minutes == 0:
+        return f"{seconds}s"
+    return f"{minutes}m{seconds}s"
